ablation: 50 repair stage only, not extra end-to-end arm

data.numeric400: retained financial200 + fixed FinQA dev200 with full original context rendered

end_to_end: REREAD2 independent answer-only read1 then unconditional reread
SSC independent author step1 then structured check/correction
EVID36 independent facts-first initial then evidence actions
shared_initial: Independent JSON answer + brief reasoning, no evidence/self-review; all400 outputs frozen before repair. Answer-only historical results not reused.
early_stop: Stop after validated correct KEEP; changed answer or unknown may enter round2; incomplete initial remains unsubmitted for all arms.
ssc: Author prompts/parser/one-cycle branching unchanged; repeat repair-only cycle at most2 times. If author correction emits no new rationale, mark it unavailable and retain prior error analysis as historical analysis, never pass stale reasoning as a new rationale.
evidence_memory: Carry own ledger, scope and uncertainty. Namespace previous round evidence IDs, preserving mapping and raw content; do not share method evidence.
reread_match: Same COMMON; match EVID36 logical call count per round, no EVID answers/evidence/gold passed; includes up to8 calls, not forced if EVID early-stops.
scoring: unchanged historical display_match OR exec_match; FinQA answer/exe_ans native references; fixed400 denominator including failures

metrics.detection_coverage: declared correct_or_incorrect on C/W divided by C+W

primary_comparisons: repair round2 numeric400 SSC vs EVID
repair round2 mixed400 SSC vs EVID
statistics: exact paired McNemar; Holm over four primary comparisons; source-stratified table-cluster bootstrap; other tests exploratory
diagnostic_injection: Separate clearly synthetic diagnostic only; not in natural-error main scores or sample selection.
publication: Private preparation only. No automatic GitHub upload. Upstream SSC redistribution permission and source-data rights require review before publishing.
